$comment: Shared trigger-matching matrix. The frontend matcher (apps/web/src/components/capabilities/skills/trigger-matcher.ts) and the backend matcher (apps/api/src/api/services/skill_injection.py _trigger_hits) must return identical hits for every case. Consumed by apps/web/src/components/capabilities/skills/__tests__/trigger-matcher.test.ts and apps/api/tests/test_skill_trigger_matching.py. Rule: a declared trigger matches when every token of the phrase appears somewhere in the message; order and adjacency do not matter; token equality does (parse does not match parser).

cases.name: filler words between trigger tokens still match
cases.message: please tailor my resume for acme

cases.name: leading and trailing filler words do not block
cases.message: can you tailor the resume please

cases.name: repeated whitespace is irrelevant
case is irrelevant and the declared casing is echoed
punctuation does not block a match
cases.message: Please tailor my resume, then send it.

cases.name: token equality: parse does not match parser
cases.message: my parser was misbehaving while testing

cases.name: token equality: exact tokens match
every token of the phrase is required
order and adjacency do not matter
unrelated message activates nothing
cases.message: what is the weather in oslo

cases.name: empty message matches nothing
whitespace-only message matches nothing
punctuation-only message matches nothing
OR semantics across declared phrases
cases.message: I need a cover letter for this role

cases.name: multiple phrases can hit at once in declared order
cases.message: please tailor my resume with resume tailoring ideas

cases.name: numbers split into tokens
underscore is a word character
unicode letters match case-insensitively
a punctuation-only trigger can never match
no triggers declared yields no hits (eligibility is the caller's concern)
